name: doffin-mcp
description: Doffin (deals): search_postings. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_doffin_subscription_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_DOFFIN_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY
platform_mcp_doffin_subscription_key.description: Subscription key for the 'Public API' product from the Doffin API developer portal (https://dof-notices-prod-api.developer.azure-api.net/, sign up → Products → subscribe), sent as the Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: GET https://api.doffin.no/public/v2/search (Public API 'search': numHitsPerPage ≤ 100, page, searchString, cpvCode, status, type, location, issueDateFrom/To, estimatedValueFrom/To, sortBy). `query` → searchString; `category` → one cpvCode; `min_budget` → estimatedValueFrom (an integer amount, NOK); status is fixed to ACTIVE (open notices). Response PagedPublicNoticeDto {numHitsTotal, hits[]}: title = heading, buyer = buyer[0].name, budget_max = estimatedValue.amount (the estimate, a single value) in estimatedValue.currencyCode, skills = cpvCodes, deadline as published (null on some notice types). The notice page is https://www.doffin.no/notices/<id>; notice type, lots and locations stay in raw.
